agenda_profile_subjects_paused_consisten.name: agenda_profile_subjects_paused_consistency
agenda_profile_subjects_paused_consisten.value:
("agenda"."profile_subjects"."status" = 'paused' AND "agenda"."profile_subjects"."paused_at" IS NOT NULL)
          OR ("agenda"."profile_subjects"."status" = 'active' AND "agenda"."profile_subjects"."paused_at" IS NULL)

agenda_revision_one_target.name: agenda_revision_one_target
agenda_revision_one_target.value: ("agenda"."activity_revisions"."activity_id" IS NOT NULL) <> ("agenda"."activity_revisions"."task_id" IS NOT NULL)

agenda_notification_hours_check.name: agenda_notification_hours_check
agenda_notification_hours_check.value: "agenda"."notification_preferences"."digest_hour" BETWEEN 0 AND 23 AND "agenda"."notification_preferences"."quiet_start" BETWEEN 0 AND 23 AND "agenda"."notification_preferences"."quiet_end" BETWEEN 0 AND 23 AND "agenda"."notification_preferences"."weekly_digest_hour" BETWEEN 0 AND 23 AND "agenda"."notification_preferences"."weekly_digest_day" BETWEEN 0 AND 6

agenda_subject_kit_target_check.name: agenda_subject_kit_target_check
agenda_subject_kit_target_check.value: ("agenda"."subject_kits"."subject_id" IS NOT NULL) <> ("agenda"."subject_kits"."profile_subject_id" IS NOT NULL)

agenda_task_date_origin_check.name: agenda_task_date_origin_check
agenda_task_date_origin_check.value: ("agenda"."tasks"."due_at" IS NULL AND "agenda"."tasks"."date_origin" = 'unspecified') OR ("agenda"."tasks"."due_at" IS NOT NULL AND "agenda"."tasks"."date_origin" IN ('school','relative','family','schedule'))

agenda_task_time_check.name: agenda_task_time_check
agenda_task_time_check.value: "agenda"."tasks"."time" IS NULL OR ("agenda"."tasks"."due_at" IS NOT NULL AND "agenda"."tasks"."time" ~ '^([01][0-9]|2[0-3]):[0-5][0-9]$')
